title: Excellent tour for kids
text: We had the most amazing experience! Maria was such a great guide and made the tour perfect for our 9, 8, and 5 year old.
author: Alyssa_A

title: LOVED IT 🥰 🍫 🐉 🇪🇸
text:
A fantastic family experience!!!

Our guide Leticia was vibrant, knowledgeable, energetic, and had a wonderful sense of humour. She brought the dragon stories to life and kept our jet-lagged eight year old daughter engaged throughout.

We loved discovering El Born, and the gourmet chocolate tasting/making finale was the most fabulous way to end the tour!!!  LOVED IT 🥰 🍫 🐉 🇪🇸
author: Voyager46154592670
